format: html

---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards <- mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num, name = "gps_fixes") |>
  arrange(month_num)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarise(
    valid_speed_fixes = sum(!is.na(speed)),
    min_speed = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_quartile = quantile(speed, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_speed = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    third_quartile = quantile(speed, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_speed = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  group_by(season, month, month_num) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(season, month_num)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  mallards |> filter(!is.na(speed)),
  aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = month)
) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  labs(x = "Speed", y = "Month", fill = "Month") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
